model.name: eb-insights
model.description: Feature-based Poisson GLMs (EWMA attack/defence of goals, shots on target, corners, cards, fouls; own Elo; rest days; league means) per count market, Dixon-Coles low-score correction for goals, negative-binomial totals for corners/cards. Independent of Engine A.

FIRST_TO_SCORE.note: assumes goals follow independent Poisson processes (no in-match dynamics)

RED.note: league base rate (team-level red-card modelling is not statistically defensible)

sections.assessment: Ligue 1: Engine B makes Paris SG the clear favourite (Toulouse 16% · draw 21% · Paris SG 63%). Expected goals 1.03–2.18 (total 3.21); most likely scores 1-2 (10%), 0-2 (10%), 1-1 (10%).
sections.goals: Over 2.5 goals 62%, over 1.5 83%, over 3.5 40%; both teams to score 57%. Clean sheet Toulouse 11%, Paris SG 36%.
sections.corners_note: Validation: the corners model is not yet more accurate than the league average (mean abs. error 2.73 vs 2.72 on 4,779 matches) — treat these figures as indicative.
sections.cards: Expected yellow cards 3.9 (over 3.5 54%). Red card in the match: 19% (league base rate).
sections.form: Toulouse: DLDWDWDLWD in the last 10 (3W 5D 2L), scored 16 / conceded 13; BTTS in 6, over 2.5 in 6, 2 clean sheets. Paris SG: DLWWWWWWWW in the last 10 (8W 1D 1L), scored 23 / conceded 10; BTTS in 7, over 2.5 in 7, 3 clean sheets.
sections.head_to_head: Last 6 meetings in our data: Toulouse 1 wins, Paris SG 4 wins, 1 draws (small samples; not a model input).
sections.confidence: Confidence is high (87/100) with data quality 85/100. Main uncertainty: Engine A disagrees by up to 8% on the 1X2 split.
